intellectual_tradition: Founder of Qing evidential scholarship (puxue/kaozheng), forerunner of the Zhexi school, practical statecraft learning (jingshi zhiyong); from Kunshan, Jiangsu
school: 考据学开山/浙西学派先驱/经世致用实学
representative_works: 《日知录》（三十二卷，平生精诣所在）
《天下郡国利病书》（120卷地理经世巨著）
《军制论》《形势论》《田功论》《钱粮论》（乙酉四论）
historical_significance: 顾炎武（1613-1682），字宁人，号亭林，江苏昆山人，明末清初三大思想家之一。其母王氏国亡绝食殉节，遗命'无为异国臣子'，炎武终身不仕清朝，六谒明孝陵，北游二十余年以骡马驮书考察边塞山川。学术上开清代朴学（考据学）先河，提出'读九经自考文始，考文自知音始'的实证路径；音韵学《音学五书》分古韵十部，为乾嘉学派奠基。政治思想上批判'天下兴亡，匹夫有责'语境下的君主专制（保天下者，匹夫之贱与有责焉），主张'寓封建之意于郡县之中'的分权改革，反对'独治'主张'众治'。方法论上确立'博学于文，行己有耻'的学术人格标准，'采铜于山'的原始资料原则成为考据学第一方法论准则。对乾嘉考据学、晚清经世思潮（魏源、龚自珍）及近代实证史学影响深远。
famous_quote: 天下兴亡，匹夫有责；博学于文，行己有耻；读九经自考文始，考文自知音始；文须有益于天下
influence: The Qianlong-Jiaqing evidential school honored him as its founding master; Duan Yucai and the Wang Niansun–Wang Yinzhi father and son followed his phonological path. 'The rise and fall of Tianxia is the responsibility of every commoner,' as summarized by Liang Qichao, became an emblematic slogan of modern Chinese national spirit. The Rizhilu became the model genre of Qing scholarly notebooks; the 'mining copper from the mountain' principle remains the golden rule of empirical research; his decentralized institutional thought directly influenced late-Qing local self-government currents.

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《日知录·正始》：有亡国，有亡天下。亡国与亡天下奚辨？曰：易姓改号，谓之亡国；仁义充塞，而至于率兽食人，人将相食，谓之亡天下。……保国者，其君其臣肉食者谋之；保天下者，匹夫之贱与有责焉耳矣。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: There is perishing of the state, and there is perishing of Tianxia. Dynastic overthrow is perishing of the state; when benevolence and righteousness are blocked, beasts devour men and men devour each other—that is perishing of Tianxia. Preserving the state is the concern of rulers and ministers; preserving Tianxia is the responsibility of even the lowliest commoner.
mode_evidence.source: 有亡国，有亡天下。亡国与亡天下奚辨？曰：易姓改号，谓之亡国；仁义充塞，而至于率兽食人，人将相食，谓之亡天下。……保国者，

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《日知录·郡县论》：封建之失，其专在下；郡县之失，其专在上。……寓封建之意于郡县之中，而天下治矣。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Feudalism fails through concentration below; the commandery system fails through concentration above. Embed the spirit of feudalism within the commandery system, and the realm will be well governed.
mode_evidence.source: 封建之失，其专在下；郡县之失，其专在上。……寓封建之意于郡县之中，而天下治矣。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《日知录·爱百姓故刑罚中》《亭林文集·郡县论》：人君之于天下，不能以独治也。独治之而刑繁矣，众治之而刑措矣。……以天下之权寄之天下之人。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: A sovereign cannot govern the realm alone. Rule by one multiplies punishments; rule by the many retires them. Lodge the power of the realm in the people of the realm.
mode_evidence.source: 人君之于天下，不能以独治也。独治之而刑繁矣，众治之而刑措矣。……以天下之权寄之天下之人。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《亭林文集·与人书二》《与人书三》《日知录·文须有益于天下》：君子之为学，以明道也，以救世也。徒诗文而已，所谓雕虫篆刻，亦何益哉？……凡文之不关于六经之指、当世之务者，一切不为。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The gentleman studies to illuminate the Way and to save the world. Mere poetry and prose are trifling carving—what benefit are they? All writing unrelated to the classics' import or the pressing affairs of the age, I refuse to produce.
mode_evidence.source: 君子之为学，以明道也，以救世也。徒诗文而已，所谓雕虫篆刻，亦何益哉？……凡文之不关于六经之指、当世之务者，一切不为。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《亭林文集·与人书十》：尝谓今人纂辑之书，正如今人之铸钱。古人采铜于山，今人则买旧钱名之曰废铜以充铸而已。所铸之钱既已粗恶，而又将古人传世之宝舂锉碎散，不存于后，岂不两失之乎？
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The anthologies of today are like coin-casting today: the ancients mined copper from the mountain; moderns buy old coins, call them scrap, and cast from them. Their coins are base, and the ancients' transmitted treasures are destroyed—losing on both counts.
mode_evidence.source: 尝谓今人纂辑之书，正如今人之铸钱。古人采铜于山，今人则买旧钱名之曰废铜以充铸而已。所铸之钱既已粗恶，而又将古人传世之宝舂

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《音学五书·序》《亭林文集·答李子德书》：愚以为读九经自考文始，考文自知音始。以至诸子百家之书，亦莫不然。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Reading the Nine Classics begins with philology, and philology begins with phonology. The same holds for all the philosophical schools.
mode_evidence.source: 愚以为读九经自考文始，考文自知音始。以至诸子百家之书，亦莫不然。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《亭林文集·与友人论学书》《日知录·廉耻》：士而不先言耻，则为无本之人；非好古而多闻，则为空虚之学。以无本之人而讲空虚之学，吾见其日从事于去圣弥远也。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: A scholar who does not first speak of shame is a person without root; learning that is not steeped in the ancients and rich in knowledge is empty learning. A rootless person expounding empty learning drifts daily further from the sages.
mode_evidence.source: 士而不先言耻，则为无本之人；非好古而多闻，则为空虚之学。以无本之人而讲空虚之学，吾见其日从事于去圣弥远也。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《天下郡国利病书·序》《亭林佚文》：余出游四方，考其山川风俗、疾苦利病，如指诸掌。……载书自随，遍历塞上亭障。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: In my travels across the realm I examined its mountains, rivers, customs, sufferings, strengths, and ills as clearly as the palm of my hand, carrying my books with me through every frontier fortification.
mode_evidence.source: 余出游四方，考其山川风俗、疾苦利病，如指诸掌。……载书自随，遍历塞上亭障。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《音学五书·古音表》《诗本音》：考古人之音，不当以后世之音律之。……《诗》三百篇其韵文者什九，读之而知其有变也。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: Ancient pronunciation must not be judged by later pronunciation. Of the three hundred Shijing poems, nine parts rhyme—reading them reveals systematic variation.
mode_evidence.source: 考古人之音，不当以后世之音律之。……《诗》三百篇其韵文者什九，读之而知其有变也。

mode_evidence.evidence_zh: 《亭林文集·与施愚山书》：愚独以为理学之名，自宋人始有之。古之所谓理学，经学也，非数十年不能通也。……今之所谓理学，禅学也。
mode_evidence.evidence_en: The name 'principle-learning' began with the Song. What the ancients called principle-learning was classical studies, requiring decades to master. What is called principle-learning today is Chan Buddhism.
mode_evidence.source: 愚独以为理学之名，自宋人始有之。古之所谓理学，经学也，非数十年不能通也。……今之所谓理学，禅学也。

cross_references.description_zh: 顾炎武重‘经世’与‘考据’，黄宗羲更重‘制度设计’与‘学术史整体构建’；顾重‘亡国’的教训，黄重‘政治体制’的根本重构。
cross_references.description_en: Gu emphasized statecraft and evidential scholarship, while Huang Zongxi stressed institutional design and the systematic construction of intellectual history; Gu drew lessons from the fall of the state, Huang from the fundamental reconstruction of the political order.

cross_references.description_zh: 王夫之重‘历史循环论’与‘气一元论’的形而上建构，顾炎武重‘实证考据’与‘实地调研’的现实指向；王偏哲学思辨，顾偏方法工程与知识工程。
cross_references.description_en: Wang Fuzhi built metaphysical systems of historical cycles and qi-monism; Gu pursued empirical textual verification and field research—Wang leaned to philosophical speculation, Gu to method and knowledge engineering.

cross_references.description_zh: 董仲舒以‘天人感应’建立经学的宇宙论神学，顾炎武以‘经学即理学’剥离经学的神秘化、建立文本实证路线——两者分别代表经学的神学化与实证化两个历史方向。
cross_references.description_en: Dong Zhongshu theologized the classics with cosmic resonance; Gu Yanwu de-mystified them through the program 'classical studies as principle-learning'—the theological versus the empirical directions of classical studies.

modern_value_zh: 天下兴亡匹夫有责——责任伦理思维：把公共事务的责任主体从‘上面’拉回到每一个普通人
采铜于山——一手资料思维：拒绝转引二手，凡结论必回到原始证据
经世致用——问题导向思维：研究选题由现实利病反向定义，知识以实效验收
寓封建于郡县——制度杂交思维：对立制度的优点做结构性组合，而非整体替换
行己有耻——底线思维：道德从高标降为可日日自验的底线，人人可行
modern_value_en: Tianxia as everyone's responsibility: pull the subject of public responsibility from 'above' back to every ordinary person
Mining copper from the mountain: refuse second-hand citation; every conclusion returns to primary evidence
Statecraft-oriented learning: define research topics backward from real problems; validate knowledge by practical effect
Embedding feudalism within the commandery: structurally hybridize opposing institutions' strengths rather than wholesale replacement
Conducting oneself with shame: lower morality from lofty ideals to a daily verifiable baseline accessible to all
place_of_origin: Kunshan County, Suzhou Prefecture (now Kunshan, Jiangsu)
unique_thing: Gu Yanwu's core achievement was 'a relocation of the foundations of knowledge': he moved scholarly legitimacy from inner moral intuition back to external textual and empirical evidence—'classical studies is principle-learning,' 'read the classics beginning with philology, philology beginning with phonology,' 'mine copper from the mountain.' He was not merely a scholar but a man of action who refused to serve the new dynasty for life, traveling the northern frontiers for over twenty years with books on pack mules, turning geography, economy, and military affairs into auditable governance data. His 'ten ancient rhyme categories' overturned a millennium of errors with an evidence-exhausted inductive system. He proved: the soundness of knowledge does not depend on the loftiness of doctrine but on the completeness of evidence—the greatest legacy of evidential scholarship is that rule of 'broadly learned in culture, conducting oneself with shame': the pursuit of knowledge and the baseline of conduct can never be separated.
